audit: independent source-only review; no board, SDK, or controller execution

guards.tmpfs_free_min: all staging including input + 1 GiB + 100 MiB

post_run_required: Verify all returned source/config hashes, two successful releases, monitor errors and pre/post driver.
Verify both actual F32 outputs finite, SHA and five-port parity against archived original graph, not only in-process repeat counts.
Verify actual NPD VNPD v2 target 0x1000003b record stride128 and SDK/prior parser equality; map only exact-NB matching trace.
Separate NN busy counter shares from elapsed time and do not invent engine/CPU fallback labels.
Do not use NPD/IO instrumented times as pure speed, TTFT or full-range 100ms qualification.
limitations: Two-layer L0/L1 single canonical trajectory at history128, not full24-layer prefill.
History derives from FP32 reference prefix rather than live NPU KV.
No audio/RAG concurrency or stability qualification.
Explicit root disk artifacts are zero; system logging and swap writes remain possible.
No statement about actual board run success until evidence recovery.

resolved_hardening.detail: Pinned NB and output size already bind this reviewed run; add metrics scope=two_layer_probe/capacity512/query_rows256/fusion_layers2 for fail-fast diagnostic validation.

Current runner verifies npd_enabled, return code, repeat output and records all artifact hashes. Require exactly one nonempty *.npd for NPD and no *.npd for IO before declaring diagnostics complete; offline parser currently fails on missing artifact.
